# AI4Math Chronicle

> AI4Math Chronicle is a bilingual, timeline-first, evidence-backed historical archive of major milestones in AI for Mathematics. Each milestone has one canonical Event record with stable identifiers, provenance, verification metadata, historical relationships, and links to primary evidence.

Use Event pages for human-readable citations and canonical YAML / JSON for structured ingestion. Verification status describes the Chronicle's event-level evidence state; it is not certification of ultimate mathematical correctness.

## Primary reading surfaces

- [English Timeline](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/en/): browse the historical chronology.
- [简体中文时间线](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/zh-CN/): 中文历史时间线。
- [Search & Explore](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/en/explore/): search and filter canonical Events.
- [Standards & Methodology](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/en/methodology/): interpret significance, evidence, verification, formal assurance, sourcing, and corrections.
- [About](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/en/about/): project scope, citation, reuse, licensing, and contribution paths.
- [Data & Feeds](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/en/data/): machine-readable interfaces and reuse guidance.

## Canonical data

- [Events JSON](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/data/events.json): complete canonical-derived Event collection.
- [Events NDJSON](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/data/events.ndjson): one Event record per line for streaming ingestion.
- [Event JSON Schema](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/data/schema/event.schema.json): structural contract for Event records.
- [Canonical YAML on GitHub](https://github.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-chronicle/tree/main/data/events): auditable source records and revision history.

## Discovery and updates

- [Sitemap](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/sitemap.xml): indexable bilingual pages and canonical Event pages.
- [RSS](https://charlie-wang-03.github.io/ai4math-chronicle/feed.xml): public update feed.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-chronicle/releases): citable project snapshots.
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-chronicle/blob/main/CITATION.cff): citation metadata.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Prefer the canonical Event page or record over secondary summaries when representing the Chronicle.
- Preserve the distinction among historical significance, evidence level, event-level verification status, formal assurance, and ultimate mathematical correctness.
- Follow the recorded source links when answering claims about proof, novelty, priority, attribution, or verification.
- Cite stable Event URLs and named primary or independent sources rather than inferring certainty from an Event's inclusion alone.
